## opencode-openspec-plugin v0.3.0

### Features
- Change detail opens as three collapsible sections – Proposal, Design and Tasks; Tasks expanded by default
- Proposal shows proposal.md with Why, What Changes and other sections under their own labels, with a teaser on the collapsed summary
- Design shows design.md for changes that have one, rendered through a lightweight Markdown component
- Task count moves into the progress bar beneath the change name; group titles hang to the left of their tasks

### Improvements
- Delete button is blocked while the agent is busy, consistent with Apply and Update
**npm:** [`@vladislavlad/opencode-openspec-plugin`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vladislavlad/opencode-openspec-plugin)

## opencode-openspec-plugin v0.3.0

### Features
- Spec search: a field above Specifications filters by name, Purpose, requirements and scenarios; query carries over inside each spec
- Init shows progress – specs appear in the sidebar as they are derived, with a status line naming the current stage
- Interrupted setup offers Resume from the first unfinished stage or instant Dismiss (no agent turn)
- Setup talks to you in your language, keeping OpenSpec terms in English
- Derivation depth question up front: Overview reads entry points; Deep follows real code paths including error handling
- Task granularity choice: High-level (a few broad tasks) or Detailed (sub-tasks grouped under sections)
- Deriving specs now covers non-application projects – infrastructure, config and tooling repos get specs for what they provision

### Improvements
- Release notes reach you however you updated – manual `npm i -g`, unpinned specifier, or the Update button all show them
- Completed Changes auto-expand on first appearance

**npm:** [`@vladislavlad/opencode-openspec-plugin`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vladislavlad/opencode-openspec-plugin)

## opencode-openspec-plugin v0.2.0

### Features
- Sidebar actions: Explore, Propose, Archive (disabled while the agent works)
- Guided Init: installs the OpenSpec CLI, configures, and derives specs
- New /opsx-* commands work right after Init; reopen for full support
- Task progress under Active Changes; animated "Initializing" state

**npm:** [`@vladislavlad/opencode-openspec-plugin`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vladislavlad/opencode-openspec-plugin)

## opencode-openspec-plugin v0.1.7

A TUI sidebar for [opencode](https://opencode.ai) that brings the OpenSpec workflow into the terminal: browse specs, review change proposals, and track task progress.

### Features
- OpenSpec sidebar with **Active / Completed Changes** and **Specifications** sections, showing requirement counts
- Task progress for active changes, drill-in into specs and requirements
- keywords highlighting
- Apply / Update / Archive actions
- OpenSpec slash commands

**npm:** [`@vladislavlad/opencode-openspec-plugin`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vladislavlad/opencode-openspec-plugin)
